symptoms: exact finisher candidates reduced unconnected count but reintroduced shorts
long-net candidate ordering buried obstacle-aware detours behind dogbone vias
candidate via sites near other-net pads/tracks reached KiCad DRC and wasted route budget

rootCause: The exact finisher was still prioritizing legacy dogbone candidates for long nets and only prefiltered segment short-risk. Candidate vias placed too close to other-net pads/tracks were sent to full KiCad DRC, and obstacle-aware detours were often never attempted.
fixSummary: Generate obstacle-aware wide-channel and layer-channel detours before local bridge candidates, remove the long-net dogbone priority inversion, and prefilter candidate via sites against other-net pads/tracks/vias before expensive DRC.

testsAdded: exact finisher prefilters obvious short-risk candidates before KiCad DRC
exact finisher generates obstacle-aware detour candidates before local bridges

conditions: DRC clean board has exact unconnected leftovers
vias are placed near other-net pads/tracks
legacy dogbone candidates exhaust route budget before obstacle detours

recipe: Run DRC and parse exact unconnected endpoints.
Generate obstacle-aware detour candidates before local same-row bridge candidates.
Reject predicted short-risk segments and via sites before KiCad DRC.
Run each remaining physical candidate in isolation.
Promote only candidates that reduce exact/global connectivity while keeping DRC/shorts/forbidden vias at zero.
If stage exhausts, escalate to controlled placement nudge or regional routeability optimization.
safetyRules: Do not modify protected ESC/FC projects.
Do not promote candidates with shorts.
Do not use blind, buried, micro, or via-in-pad vias.
Do not count segment count as routing success.
